title: After the deal, Yoshua replies NO to the paycheck watch; Thursday passes silently
judgeNotes: 'no' cancels the watch (confirmed in a short text). On Thursday night no paycheck-watch text arrives (the reminder about tomorrow's payment may still come).

title: Paycheck watch fires Thursday; Yoshua says it's coming Monday; second call

steps.yoshua: tell PacePay your employer said the paycheck is delayed until Monday
pick the option where PacePay calls the lender again

judgeNotes: The late-paycheck options must reflect the already-moved car payment (now Fri Nov 13 + $20 fee) and the paycheck on Mon Nov 16; the second call asks to move it again to after Monday. Both Done texts accurate.

title: Right after the deal, 'fyi my paycheck is delayed till monday', picks savings

steps.say: fyi my paycheck is delayed till monday

judgeNotes: News is not read as an answer to the watch question. Options computed on the new state. Savings choice: no second call; clear steps he does himself.

title: No case: 'what if my paycheck is late next week?' then 'nah dont watch it'

steps.say: what if my paycheck is late next week?

judgeNotes: A what-if answer with the correct numbers (paycheck Thu Nov 12); the 'nah' cancels the watch with a short confirmation.

title: No case: 'my paycheck is going to be 4 days late' -> options -> pick call -> deal

steps.say: my paycheck is going to be 4 days late this time, landing monday the 16th

judgeNotes: With no repair, a Monday paycheck makes the mortgage (Mon) and car payment (Tue) tight; check the numbers and options are right and honest.
